name: Mini Civ
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: A Civilization-style strategy game: found cities, build units such as knights and triremes and grow your empire turn by turn.

descriptions.en: A Civilization-style strategy game: found cities, build units such as knights and triremes and grow your empire turn by turn.
descriptions.it: Uno strategico in stile Civilization: fonda città, produci unità come cavalieri e triremi e fai crescere il tuo impero turno dopo turno.
